why: Milk's buff scales with her own ATK, and she has to stay ATK #1 for 열정페이/초고속승진. Even SSR skill-amp lines get rerolled to ATK%. ATK% runes are basically Milk-only.

lines: Skill haste first (target 40–50 total with gear), then skill amp / crit dmg
why: More haste keeps more of her 6 drones up in a fight that ends at 17 s. The study puts the breakpoint near 40 total haste; top posters run 44.6–49.6. Gear already supplies about 27, so runes add roughly 15–22.
disputed: At 58.6 haste, 1–2 drones peeled off onto adds (dc:75934). If your team dies at the 30 s slam, the model says skill amp beats haste. Some run 4 haste + 2 skill amp once 10★; the 1.62T run did exactly that (dc:75462).

disputed: alkapa.gg's raid tag recommends ATK% for Macaron, Skating Queen and Cheesecake. Every forum guide from 9/17 on says skill amp.

why: Her ATK buff on Milk grows with skill amp. Haste is wasted because gear already provides it.
